waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Good weekend vibes for Tesoro Highlands — here's what's worth your time:

🎃 *Sat 9 AM* — Gilchrist Farm Harvest Festival & Pumpkin Patch (free)
   Perfect for little ones: pumpkins, hayrides, harvest fun
📚 *Sat 11 AM* — Weekly Saturday Storytime at Barnes & Noble Valencia (free)
   Saturday storytime for the toddler crowd
🛍️ *Sat 12 PM* — SoCal Etsy Guild Market (free)
   Local makers market, browse and support small businesses
🍺 *Fri 6 PM* — Live Music at Lucky Luke Brewing Company (free)
   Live music and good beer for a Friday night out
🎤 *Sat 8 PM* — Standup Comedy @ Red Dot Pizza ($17.85)
   Saturday night laughs — standup comedy at Red Dot Pizza
🥕 *Sun 8 AM* — Santa Clarita Certified Farmers Market (free)
   Sunday morning farmers market, fresh local produce

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
